transcription_notes: Hand: regular upright Ethiopic book hand, 3 columns/page, dense, with heavy red rubrication of clause-initial words and divine names in the RUNNING text and red cross-shaped (✣) clause dividers. Verses NOT numbered; segmented by the manuscript's own ✣ sense-dividers + red ክፍл rubric breaks + narrative sense, numbered contiguously 1-58. CAUTION (structural): the red ✣ ክፍл ፡ N ✣ rubrics are FINE LITURGICAL SUBDIVISIONS, not modern chapters — within this single modern chapter 17 the ክፍл numerals run ፸፰(78) at the chapter opening, then ፸፱(79), ፸(80), ፸ወ፩(81), ፸ወ፪(82), ፸ወ፫(83), ፸ወ፬(84), ፸ወ፭(85), ፸ወ፮(86): nine ክፍл markers inside ONE modern chapter, numerals climbing fast. They were therefore NOT used to bound the chapter and are stripped from tokens like any rubric. Chapter bounded by the David-&-Goliath NARRATIVE only. Modern ch.16->17 START: on f111r COLUMN 3 (≈line 41 of col3): the preceding clause is 1Sa 16:23 '...ወይንሥእ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ መሰንቆ ... ወየዓርፍ ፡ ሳአл ... ወየኃድግ ፡ ዝንተ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ እኩ[ይ]' (David takes the harp, Saul is refreshed, the evil spirit departs from him); then a red ✣ ክፍл ፡ ፸፰ ✣ rubric; then ch.17 v.1 begins 'ወአስተጋብኡ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ፈልስጥኤም ፡ ተአይኒዎሙ ፡ ለፀብእ ፡ ወተጋብእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሶኮት ፡ ዘይሁዳ ፡ ወተዓየኑ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ሶኮት ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ዓዜቃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ስፍድም' — exactly the sanctioned skeleton for v.1 (the Philistines gather their armies, are gathered at Socoh of Judah, encamp between Socoh and Azekah at Ephes-dammim). Modern ch.17->18 END: on f112r COLUMN 2 (≈line 12 of col2): ch.17 ends with v.58 '...ወይቤ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወልደ ፡ ገብርከ ፡ እሴይ ፡ ቤተልሔማዊ' (Saul: 'Whose son art thou, thou young man?' — David: 'I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite'); IMMEDIATELY after this ✣ the narrative turns to 'ወኮነ ፡ እንበለ ፡ ይትፈጸም ፡ ነገር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሳአл ፡ ወነፍስ ፡ ዮናታን ፡ ተዓጾወት ፡ በነፍስ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወአፍቀሮ ፡ ዮናታን ፡ ከመ ፡ ነፍሱ ✣ ወነሥአ ፡ ሳአл ፡ ለዳዊት ... ወተካየደ ፡ ዮናታን ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ኪዳነ' = the soul of Jonathan knit with the soul of David, Jonathan loved him as his own soul, Saul took him that day, Jonathan made a covenant with David (= modern ch.18:1-3). That ch.18 material was EXCLUDED; the boundary was taken after 'ቤተልሔማዊ' (v.58). NOTE: this MS does NOT contain the women's 'thousands/ten thousands' song at the ch.17/18 seam — in this recension that song (1Sa 18:6-7) falls LATER inside ch.18 (well past the f112r columns transcribed), so the thing 'right after ch.17' here is the Jonathan-covenant opening of ch.18, NOT the women's song; the women's song is downstream and was honestly NOT reached/needed for the chapter bound. ምዕራፍ marker: no full 'ምዕራፍ' word found at the ch.16/17 or ch.17/18 joints; only small ink margin annotations reading what appears to be 'ምዕ ፡ <numeral>' (e.g. on f111r col3 a '፻፰'-type quire/chapter marginal, on f112r col2 a '፻፲፮'-type marginal) plus running book-title headers 'ነገሥት' (Negeśt = Reigns) at the head of f111r col1 and f112r col1 — these margin 'ምዕ' notes broadly corroborate a coarse-chapter region but were NOT relied on (bounding done by narrative). RECENSION (honest observed extent): this is the LONG / full form. It INCLUDES the complete David-introduction block (vv.12-31: David son of Jesse the Ephrathite, eight sons, the three eldest with Saul, David shuttling from the sheep to bring provisions, Eliab's anger) AND the full post-duel Abner / 'whose son is this youth' block (vv.55-58: Saul to Abner, Abner's 'as thy soul liveth I cannot tell', the king's 'enquire', David brought before Saul with the head, 'I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite'). Neither block is omitted/compressed; the chapter runs the equivalent of vv.1-58. Lexical/orthographic notes (kept as seen, flagged per token): the quantifier 'all/every' is written variably ኩሉ / ዘሉ (for ኵሉ); 'mountain' written defectively as ይብር (for ደብር) in v.3; 'six' (v.4) spelled out as ስድስተ rather than the numeral glyph and transcribed as the word; the numerals that ARE written as Ethiopic glyphs (፰ eight sons in v.12; ፰ and ፲ measures/loaves and ፲ cheeses in vv.17-18; ፩ 'one of them' in v.36) are each kept as standalone tokens in linear position per the numeral rule and never converted to Arabic; the 'forty days' of v.16 and the 'five' smooth stones of v.40 are NOT written as separate numeral glyphs in this MS (the clauses are given without them) — recorded as seen, not padded. Damage/condition: all three folios are clean, well-preserved parchment with a wide blank upper margin (~12-18% of page) and only light brown foxing/stains confined to the blank margins; NO staining, smudging or physical damage obscures the chapter-17 text anywhere across f111r col3, f111v cols 1-3, or f112r cols 1-2. No glyph was wholly illegible (0 ⟦illegible⟧ tokens, 0 illegible markers — counts 1:1 trivially). All uncertain[] entries are 'uncertain' markers flagging faint/defective fidels, defective spellings kept as seen, enclitic/suffix line-splits, likely dittographies (notably the vv.50/51 column-bottom repetition ወርጸ ዳዊት ... ወርጸ ዳዊት, and the vv.52/53 ጌት ... አቃሮን restatement), and the soft narrative segmentation points where a sense-unit runs across a ✣ divider or across a column/folio turn (f111r col3->f111v col1 at v.3/4; f111v col1->col2 at v.16/17; f111v col2->col3 at v.30/31; f111v col3->f112r col1 at v.42/43; f112r col1->col2 at v.55). ክፍл numerals were not transcribed as content (rubric, liturgical, NOT modern chapters).
